pages.text: Many people ask me about this. I want to talk about REITs today. I am sceptical and warn that advertised returns are overstated. Read the small print, because returns in adverts are overstated. REIT distributions are taxed at only 5 percent.

Unit holders receive a share of rental income as distributions. A trustee holds the property on behalf of unit holders and a manager runs the portfolio. Do your own research before you act. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
